name: Gitea
description: 提供 Git 仓库、HTTP 与 SSH 访问。

initializeCommand:
umask 077
stamp=/data/.iquops-gitea-admin-init-v1
admins=$(su-exec git gitea --config /data/gitea/conf/app.ini admin user list --admin)
read_admin() {
  printf '%s\n' "$admins" | awk -v name="$GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME" '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && tolower($2) == tolower(name) && $4 == "true" {print $1}'
}
admin_id=$(read_admin)
if [ -z "$admin_id" ]; then
  [ ! -e "$stamp" ]
  su-exec git gitea --config /data/gitea/conf/app.ini admin user create --username "$GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME" --email "$GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL" --password "$GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD" --admin --must-change-password=true >/dev/null
  admins=$(su-exec git gitea --config /data/gitea/conf/app.ini admin user list --admin)
  admin_id=$(read_admin)
  [ -n "$admin_id" ]
fi
# 数据卷仅保存已验证初始化输入的摘要。用户自行改密后，例行重启沿用既有初始化记录。
fingerprint=$(printf '%s\0' "$admin_id" "$GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME" "$GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL" "$GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD" | sha256sum | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
[ ! -L "$stamp" ]
if [ -f "$stamp" ] && [ "$(cat "$stamp")" = "$fingerprint" ]; then exit 0; fi
printf '%s\n' "$admins" | awk -v id="$admin_id" -v email="$GITEA_ADMIN_EMAIL" '$1 == id && tolower($3) == tolower(email) {found=1} END {exit !found}'
body=$(mktemp)
next=$(mktemp /data/.iquops-gitea-admin-init.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$body" "$next"' EXIT
auth=$(printf '%s:%s' "$GITEA_ADMIN_USERNAME" "$GITEA_ADMIN_PASSWORD" | base64 | tr -d '\n')
status=$(printf 'Authorization: Basic %s\n' "$auth" | curl --silent --show-error --max-time 8 --header @- --output "$body" --write-out '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/user)
case "$status" in
  200) grep -Eq '"is_admin"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' "$body" ;;
  403) grep -Fq 'You must change your password. Change it at:' "$body" ;;
  *) exit 1 ;;
esac
printf '%s\n' "$fingerprint" >"$next"
mv -f "$next" "$stamp"
